normalized.result: Yes, that's the right way to handle it. A backup that fails is worrying, so the reassuring thing is exactly what it does: it tells me plainly that it didn't work, makes clear my library itself is untouched and safe — I haven't lost anything — and instead of leaving me stuck, it turns the button into "Retry full backup" so I can just try again. That's honest without being alarming, and it points me straight at what to do next. Settled.
